CA.rationale: A content-processing condition (command_estimate) is explicitly linked to the same candidate content (red) and its origin.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified and separately tied to an organization/status (origin) for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: A processing condition ('command_estimate') is explicitly linked to the same candidate content and its presentation.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (red positions) are listed with referents and coordinates.

D.rationale: Content identity (red) is presented separately from its status/organization (origin) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report states how contents are represented/accessed (origins, represented_time, inherited_current/history_estimate) indicating presentation/organization.
